summary: Excellent multi-layer test suite: unit tests for each module function with mocking, CLI integration tests with real config, workflow structure validation, and end-to-end act harness verifying exact output. Covers all major requirements (both manifest formats, policy classification, report formatting, error handling, CI/CD workflow). Strong edge case coverage (malformed JSON, missing files, extras stripping, range operators, null licenses, case-insensitivity). Well-organized, readable code with appropriate fixtures and isolation. Minor gaps: no filesystem anomaly tests, special character handling untested, minimal mock parameter verification. Act harness assumptions about fixture files not cross-checked. This suite would effectively catch most regressions across all layers of the system.
